style: Original cute anime-style game asset for a cozy mobile ranch game set in a peaceful, whimsical Three Kingdoms era Chinese countryside. Soft cel shading, clean dark-brown outlines, pastel palette (sky blue, sakura pink, cream, mint green), gentle highlights, big round sparkly eyes, kawaii and warm. Single centered subject, three-quarter view, no text, no letters, no watermark, no frame, no border, no ground shadow, isolated on a fully transparent background. Consistent with a matching set of game icons.
